title: Actual and Relevant
style: Funk, polished live-band mix, driving midtempo syncopated groove, tight syncopated bass, clipped rhythm guitar, dry punchy drums, sharp horn stabs, organ accents, conversational male lead with call-and-response backing vocals, verse-forward arrangement with pre-choruses, memorable chorus, bridge, break, final chorus, and outro
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Before the fossils found their place
Before the family tree had a name
Some people looked at heaven’s throne
And said, “I don’t see anyone home”

Others watched the turning sky
And pictured a maker standing by
A first bright spark, a distant hand
Then left the world to run as planned

[Pre-Chorus]
So don’t confuse the map with the road
Or the question with the code

[Chorus]
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
That story’s wearing borrowed clothes
It made agnostics out of deists
When the universe kept moving on its own
You can kneel, you can doubt, you can pray, you can leave
But the evidence won’t tell you what to believe
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
It changed the shape of what we know

[Verse 2]
There are Christians in the laboratory light
Theistic Jews reading genes tonight
Pagans finding wonder in the living chain
Faith and common descent can share a frame

And there were doubters long before
The word “evolution” crossed the door
No grand new theory had to arrive
To make a god feel absent from their lives

[Pre-Chorus]
The issue isn’t how the branches grew
It’s whether something divine feels real to you

[Chorus]
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
That story’s wearing borrowed clothes
It made agnostics out of deists
When the universe kept moving on its own
You can kneel, you can doubt, you can pray, you can leave
But the evidence won’t tell you what to believe
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
It changed the shape of what we know

[Bridge]
What does a person need to say “I’m free”?
Not a war with biology
Not a fight with every sacred name
Just no god felt actual, no god felt relevant
No presence answering the frame

[Break]
Actual and relevant
Actual and relevant
That’s the line beneath the argument
Actual and relevant

[Final Chorus]
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
Faith has never been one single road
It made agnostics out of deists
When a distant clockmaker lost control
You can kneel, you can doubt, you can pray, you can leave
The living world is not a verdict on belief
Evolution didn’t make atheists out of theists
It changed the shape of what we know

[Outro]
Not every believer fears the tree
Not every doubter needed Darwin to see
The question keeps its steady beat:
Is any god actual and relevant to me?
